ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white distal lobes) to 35% low-intensity pixels (black central and medial regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white segments occupy the distal 2/3 of both lobes. A low-intensity black region forms a central 'butterfly' shape anchored at the peduncle. Multiple low-intensity punctate spots (mottling) are distributed across the white distal surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio within its bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; specifically pronounced with deep 'valleys' on the medial side of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning into a sharp convex trajectory towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast dark pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips; sparse, roughly circular black spots (focal points) scattered across the white ventral surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the black central pigment, primarily oriented in horizontal and diagonal trajectories.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy scarring or barnacle colonization visible at both distal tips; significant linear rake marks in the central black pigmentation area.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical trailing edge profile where the right lobe exhibits significantly deeper serration amplitude than the left lobe.
